# buddy_ruleset (Resource)

Create and manage a ruleset that protects branches and tags of a project. Only workspace administrators and project managers can manage rulesets

Token scopes required: `RULESET_READ`, `RULESET_MANAGE`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "buddy_ruleset" "protect_main" {
  domain       = "mydomain"
  project_name = "myproject"
  identifier   = "protect-main"
  name         = "Protect main"
  note         = "Main changes only through pull requests with a green build"
  agent_note   = "Open a pull request instead of pushing to main"
  refs         = [":default"]

  bypass_admins = true
  bypass_others = "DENIED"

  bypass_user {
    id     = 123
    access = "ALLOWED"
  }

  bypass_group {
    id     = 456
    access = "ALLOWED"
  }

  required_pipelines           = ["build"]
  required_unit_tests_suites   = ["backend-junit"]
  required_visual_tests_suites = ["storybook"]
  require_up_to_date           = true
  require_pull_request         = true
  block_force_push             = true
  restrict_deletion            = true
}

resource "buddy_ruleset" "release_tags" {
  domain            = "mydomain"
  project_name      = "myproject"
  identifier        = "release-tags"
  refs              = ["refs/tags/v*"]
  bypass_admins     = true
  restrict_creation = true
  restrict_update   = true
  restrict_deletion = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The workspace's URL handle
- `identifier` (String) The ruleset's identifier, unique in the project regardless of letter case
- `project_name` (String) The project's name
- `refs` (Set of String) Patterns of the refs the ruleset protects, 1-20. Same syntax as refs in pipelines: `refs/heads/main`, `refs/tags/v*`, a short name (matches both a branch and a tag), a wildcard, a regex in parentheses, or `:default` for the default branch

### Optional

- `agent_note` (String) The ruleset's note for agents
- `block_force_push` (Boolean) Rewriting the history of a protected branch (non-fast-forward push) is not allowed. Ignored for tags. Default: `false`
- `bypass_admins` (Boolean) `true` - workspace administrators and project managers bypass the ruleset, `false` - they do not, not set - no entry for them
- `bypass_group` (Block Set) A group that may or may not bypass the ruleset. The group must be assigned to the project (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bypass_group))
- `bypass_others` (String) Whether the remaining members with access to the project bypass the ruleset (`ALLOWED`, `DENIED`), not set - no entry for them
- `bypass_user` (Block Set) A user (agents included) who may or may not bypass the ruleset. The user must have access to the project. The user's own entry decides first, then `bypass_admins`, the user's groups, `bypass_others` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bypass_user))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the ruleset is turned off. Default: `false`
- `name` (String) The ruleset's name
- `note` (String) The ruleset's note
- `require_pull_request` (Boolean) Changes reach a protected branch only by merging a pull request. Ignored for tags. Default: `false`
- `require_up_to_date` (Boolean) The pull request branch must also contain the current state of the target branch. Default: `false`
- `required_pipelines` (Set of String) Identifiers of the pipelines that must succeed on the head commit of a pull request before it is merged. Each of them must mark commits with its status
- `required_unit_tests_suites` (Set of String) Identifiers of the unit tests suites that must pass on the head commit of a pull request before it is merged. Each of them must mark commits with its status
- `required_visual_tests_suites` (Set of String) Identifiers of the visual tests suites that must be approved on the head commit of a pull request before it is merged. Each of them must mark commits with its status
- `restrict_creation` (Boolean) Only users who bypass the ruleset may create a protected ref. Default: `false`
- `restrict_deletion` (Boolean) Only users who bypass the ruleset may delete a protected ref. Default: `false`
- `restrict_update` (Boolean) Only users who bypass the ruleset may move a protected ref, merging a pull request included. Default: `false`

### Read-Only

- `html_url` (String) The ruleset's URL
- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier for this item
- `missing_sources` (Attributes Set) Required checks whose source no longer exists or no longer marks commits with its status. Such a check blocks merging until the ruleset is fixed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--missing_sources))
- `ruleset_id` (String) The ruleset's ID

<a id="nestedblock--bypass_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bypass_group`

Required:

- `access` (String) `ALLOWED` - may bypass the ruleset, `DENIED` - may not, even when an entry checked later allows it
- `id` (Number) The ID of the group


<a id="nestedblock--bypass_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bypass_user`

Required:

- `access` (String) `ALLOWED` - may bypass the ruleset, `DENIED` - may not, even when an entry checked later allows it
- `id` (Number) The ID of the user


<a id="nestedatt--missing_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `missing_sources`

Read-Only:

- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the source
- `type` (String) `PIPELINE`, `UNIT_TESTS_SUITE` or `VISUAL_TESTS_SUITE`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using domain(mydomain), project name (myproject) and ruleset id (4GP6nQPa)
terraform import buddy_ruleset.test mydomain:myproject:4GP6nQPa
```
